name: Neighbor
description: A nosy, theatrical woman in her mid seventies from next door who sings Weimar cabaret, all raised eyebrows and gossip.
build: A small, thin older woman's frame: narrow sloping shoulders, a slight bust, thin arms and legs, standing upright with a slightly forward neck.
face: Pale pinkish-beige skin with soft wrinkles at the eyes and mouth, sharp grey eyes under thin pencilled dark brows, a pointed nose, thin lips in bright red lipstick, big round black cat-eye glasses with thick frames.
hair: Short grey hair set in rows of large bright blue plastic curlers covering the whole head.
outfit: A knee-length quilted housecoat in bold mint green with big white polka dots, buttoned down the front, short sleeves ending above the elbow; a light blue scarf knotted at the throat; fluffy yellow slippers.
performance_style: Suspicious and theatrical: feet together, weight forward. Both arms hang at the sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, every finger visible beside the thighs. Head craned forward, one brow raised, lips pursed.
location: A backyard seen over the neighbour's side: a tall weathered plank fence across the back, the next yard's grill smoke and string lights peeking over it, a patch of lawn and a flowerbed running to the bottom of the frame, and a garden gnome by the fence.
recognition_cues: rows of large bright blue curlers
a mint-green housecoat with big white polka dots
avoid: a phone or binoculars in the hands: her hands are empty

sing.intent: Cabaret vocal loop: lean forward conspiratorially, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the red lips, raise the character-left hand beside the cheek as if sharing a secret, then straighten with a dramatic flourish and return to the stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief start at a loud backyard sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: set the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: creep in on tiptoe in the slippers, peering side to side, then straighten square to the front into the stance.
